breaks.quote: a primatologist named Rachna Reddy spent years watching one thing
breaks.why: A researcher who need not be kept is named in Insight 1, then repeated as 'Reddy calls it' and 'what Reddy watched', so the reader carries a name they did not need.
An invented chimp name is added on top of the researcher, the park and the group, so the reader holds several names for a story they only need for its lesson.
